product_name: FC-3000 智能铁磁探测系统
summary: FC-3000智能铁磁探测系统是一款被动式探测铁磁性物质的设备，拥有世界领先的磁通门检测、DSP数字信号处理等核心技术，通过智能软件算法排除周围环境干扰的限制因素，FC-3000是便携的、安全的、可信任的产品。
summary_en: The FC-3000 Intelligent Ferromagnetic Detection System is a passive detection device for ferromagnetic materials, with world-leading fluxgate detection and DSP digital signal processing core technologies. Through intelligent software algorithms, it eliminates the limiting factors of surrounding environmental interference. The FC-3000 is a portable, safe, and trustworthy product.
key_application: 应用领域：FC-3000 智能铁磁探测系统；被动式无源探测，无电磁辐射；高灵敏度识别各类磁性违禁品；支持隐蔽筛查与联网分级预警。
key_application_en: Passive electromagnetic-safe ferromagnetic detection; nanotesla-level sensitivity for hidden metals; 3-zone positioning for precise identification; discrete/covert screening capable; high-throughput 60+ ppm.
key_parameter_1: 探测灵敏度: 纳特斯拉 (nT) 级
key_parameter_2: 电池续航: ≥ 24 小时 (内置大容量锂电)

parameters.探测技术: 被动式磁通门检测 + 高性能 DSP 处理
parameters.识别能力: 精准探测含磁性金属及非金属 (铁、钴、镍及合金)
parameters.安全性: 无源探测，不产生电磁辐射，通过 CE/QMS 认证
parameters.警报模式: 可视化智能报警 (红/绿灯)、声音报警、可选隐蔽报警 (智能手表联接)
parameters.定位功能: 铁磁物品三分区定位显示
parameters.联网模式: 双柱联网支持分级预警 (打火机/手机/管制刀具区分)
parameters.探测范围: 半径 0 - 1.5 米 360 度全方位覆盖
parameters.结构材质: 轻量化高强度铝合金柱身

parameters_en.Technology: Passive Fluxgate Detection with High-Performance DSP Processing
parameters_en.Detection Targets: Precisely scans for ferromagnetic metals/non-metals (Iron, Cobalt, Nickel)
parameters_en.Radiation Safety: Passive sensing only; zero EM emission; certified CE/QMS
parameters_en.Alarm Interface: Visual alerts (Red/Green), high-fidelity audio, and optional discreet vibrating watch link
parameters_en.Spatial Resolution: 3-zone vertical positioning for accurate item localization
parameters_en.Intelligent Networking: Dual-column linking for hierarchical warnings (Lighter/Phone/Knife differentiation)
parameters_en.Industrial Rating: IP65 Weatherproof; suitable for indoor/outdoor use
parameters_en.Endurance: Internal Li-battery supports > 24 hours of operation; Type-C charging

detail_html:
产品功能

  • 检测含磁性的金属和非金属物品。
  • 非接触式无源探测，低功耗，不发射有害电磁波。
  • 实时、可视化智能报警。
  • 灵敏度高，NT级，检测铁磁物品三分区定位。
  • 检测范围宽，0-1.5米以此为半径的360度范围。
  • 通过速率高，＞60人次/每分钟。
  • 隐蔽筛查，可放置在物体、门及墙后，可配合智能手表报警，外形可根据安检场所进行隐蔽设计。
  • 内置大容量锂电池可正常运行＞24小时。
  • 双柱联网模式：分级预警功能。（打火机等蓝灯、手机黄灯、管制类刀具红灯）
detail_html_en:
Product Functions

  • Detects metallic and non-metallic items containing ferromagnetic material.
  • Non-contact passive detection, low power consumption, emits no harmful electromagnetic waves.
  • Real-time, visualized intelligent alarm.
  • High sensitivity, NT level, three-zone positioning for detected ferromagnetic items.
  • Wide detection range, 360-degree coverage within a 0-1.5 meter radius.
  • High throughput rate, >60 persons/minute.
  • Covert screening, can be placed behind objects, doors and walls, can be paired with smart watch for alarm, appearance can be designed for concealment according to security venue.
  • Built-in large-capacity lithium battery, normal operation >24 hours.
  • Dual-column network mode: hierarchical warning function. (Lighter: blue light, phone: yellow light, controlled knives: red light)
category_primary: Security Screening & Policing (安检与智慧警务装备)
category_secondary: Safety Inspection Gates (安检门/探测门)
category_tertiary: Ferromagnetic Detection Systems (铁磁探测柱系统)
